body:
SOURCE-FIT CONTRACT PROPOSAL, still no code/reservation. Current types let this remain a single new JVM module plus build.sbt; no acquire or amr-interop edit is needed. provider-parser would depend on core.jvm, proposition.jvm, acquire.jvm, and amrInterop.jvm, with its own Circe envelope codec.

1. ParserSentenceInput is constructed only from SurfaceAtlas + a sentence id. It stores the exact atlas sentence text/checksum and the sentence-local ordered token vector (token id, exact text, exact TextSpan). There is no public constructor from arbitrary parallel tokenization.
2. ParserBatch validates unique request ids. AmrCandidateProvider[F] returns ParserBatchResult. A conforming wrapper always emits attempts in request order and exactly once. Raw missing/duplicate/extra/reordered IDs become recorded BatchDecision values; missing/duplicate items become typed failed attempts while valid siblings survive.
3. Each ParserAttempt contains request id, Either[ParserFailure, PropositionEvidence], and ParserAttemptReceipt. The receipt is parser-specific and may contain Option[ProviderCall]; it is NOT AgentCallReceipt and never invents PromptPackageRef. Preflight RuntimeDependencyUnpinned, transport failure, or cache-only replay legitimately has no new provider call but still has a content-addressed attempt record.
4. Success requires response token ids/text/spans byte-equal to the request, strict AmrCandidates.fromPenman using sentence-local atlas TokenSpans, chart.sentence equal to the request sentence, nonempty chart.alignments, and every alignment span contained in that sentence. Otherwise TokenEchoMismatch, InteropRejected, or AlignmentMissing. Checked/aligned coverage remains distinct from a separately reported semantic-nonvacuity count.
5. The raw versioned JSON envelope contains schema version, request id, echoed provider tokens, PENMAN or typed provider failure, model/runtime metadata, and sanitized diagnostics. Malformed JSON fails every requested id explicitly; raw stderr/text is hashed, not copied into failure messages.
6. Runtime is a closed Ready(PinnedRuntime, transport) | Unavailable(RuntimeDependencyUnpinned) state. PinnedRuntime requires source/package/checkpoint/base-image/dependency artifact identities and license evidence before Ready exists. Unavailable produces zero calls and a failed attempt for every input.
7. Cache key covers exact request rendering plus runtime/config fingerprint. Replay emits no transport calls, preserves the original call identity with an explicit cache decision, and revalidates the cached canonical result. A second uncached execution under the same pin compares a canonical chart-plus-alignment digest; mismatch is Nondeterministic and uncovered, while raw PENMAN whitespace/variable renaming alone is not a scientific mismatch.

Proposed files after chief approval: build.sbt; provider-parser/README.md; provider-parser/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/provider/parser/{contract,envelope,codec,conforming,cache}.scala; matching Contract/Envelope/Conforming/Cache suites. Fake transport proves only this algebra. Please attack any receipt ambiguity, token-seam escape, or overlarge scope before reservation.
